subject.title: Add per-agent sandbox session visibility override feature

question: Should OpenClaw honor `agents.list[].sandbox.sessionToolsVisibility` per named sandboxed agent now, and should that land as this narrow PR rather than being folded into broader per-agent session/A2A scoping?
rationale: The current shipped config shape already accepts the field, but honoring it changes which sandboxed agents can see session state, so automation should not choose the security and consolidation direction.

options.title: Approve narrow sandbox clamp
options.body: Accept this existing-field behavior fix, require conflict resolution, and land it with tests proving defaults remain spawned and A2A policy still gates cross-agent access.

options.title: Fold into broader scoping
options.body: Pause this PR and consolidate the sandbox clamp with the broader per-agent session visibility and A2A policy work so one policy model owns the surface.

options.title: Keep default-only clamp
options.body: Close or reject the per-agent behavior and document that `sessionToolsVisibility` is only supported from `agents.defaults.sandbox` for now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow sandbox clamp
recommendation.body: Accept this existing-field behavior fix, require conflict resolution, and land it with tests proving defaults remain spawned and A2A policy still gates cross-agent access.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete for the session access helper architecture and the current-main config/schema surface touched by this security-boundary decision.
